rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a rite or a repeated set of actions, especially in a religious context.

example.english: My mother takes me to the temple every Ching Ming Festival to attend a ritual.
example.traditional: 媽媽每年清明節都帶我去寺廟參加儀式。
